title: Blizzard beta development notes, 15 Oct 2026 (racial update)

records.notes: Published in Blizzard's WoW Forever Beta development notes; the notes describe the beta client. Whether the release client matches, and the in-game effective date and build, are not verified. The post was created 2026-10-16 00:15 UTC (the evening of 15 October US Pacific time) and edited the same day. A community page associates this update with a client build; that is not independently verified, so no build is recorded.

ops.summary: Mace Specialization was replaced by Earth Fury.

set.name: Earth Fury
set.description: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

ops.summary: Replaces Mace Specialization with a 2% bonus to critical damage and healing.

details: Can stay active alongside other tracking abilities.
Also gives a chance to find additional items in most chests.

ops.summary: Now also gives a chance to find additional items in most chests.

details: Can stay active alongside other tracking abilities.

ops.summary: Sword Specialization was replaced by Ruthless.

set.name: Ruthless
set.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

ops.summary: Replaces Sword Specialization with a flat 2% critical strike chance bonus.
Axe Specialization was replaced by Savage.

set.name: Savage
set.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%.

ops.summary: Replaces Axe Specialization with a flat 1% critical strike chance bonus.
Cooldown increased from 2 to 3 minutes.

set.description: Dispels Curses and Banes and reduces Magical damage taken by 5%.

ops.summary: Now dispels Curses and Banes instead of granting immunity; the Magical damage reduction is smaller (5%, was 15%).

previous.description: Grants immunity to Curses and Banes and reduces Magical damage taken by 15%.

ops.summary: Cooldown reduced from 2 minutes to 90 seconds.
Cooldown reduced from 60 minutes to 15 minutes.

set.description: Increases total Health by 5% and your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

ops.summary: Now adds 2% critical damage and healing instead of 1% hit chance.

previous.description: Increases total Health by 5% and hit chance by 1%.

set.description: Increases movement speed the longer you stay moving, and increases mounted movement speed by 3% (stacks with other mounted speed increases).
details: You must keep moving a minimum distance per second to maintain the effect; stutter-stepping is no longer enough.

ops.summary: Also grants 3% mounted movement speed, and you must now keep moving a minimum distance to keep the effect.

previous.description: Increases movement speed the longer you stay moving.

set.description: Increases Dodge chance by 1% and run speed by 2%. The movement speed bonus stacks with other movement speed increases.

ops.summary: The movement speed bonus now stacks with other movement speed increases.

previous.description: Increases Dodge chance by 1% and run speed by 2%.

set.description: For 8 seconds, reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your abilities by 10% and increases their damage or healing by 10%. It has no charges and also benefits Power Word: Shield.
details: Cannot be used correctly while stealthed or invisible.

ops.summary: Reworked into an 8-second buff with no charges; it now also benefits Power Word: Shield.

previous.description: Reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next 3 spells or abilities by 10% and increases their damage or healing by 10%. It does not affect periodic effects; channeled spells do not count as periodic.

set.description: Increases your Health regeneration bonuses to 20%, doubling the earlier 10% of Health regeneration that continued during combat.

ops.summary: Health regeneration bonuses doubled from 10% to 20%.

previous.description: 10% of your Health regeneration continues during combat.

set.description: Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance (casters) or 20% chance (Paladins, Rogues and Warriors) to drain life from the target.
details: Does not break crowd control and only triggers from spells and abilities that have a damage component: Shadow Word: Pain triggers it on cast but not on periodic damage.
No longer scales with Shadow damage increases on the target or caster, and is not reduced when a lower-ranked spell is used.
Blizzard's October 15 notes call this ability “Touch of the Dead”.

ops.summary: Chance to trigger set per role and an internal cooldown added.

previous.description: Your attacks have a chance to drain life from enemies.
details: Does not break crowd control and only triggers from spells and abilities that have a damage component: Shadow Word: Pain triggers it on cast but not on periodic damage.
Cannot be used while affected by Scatter Shot.

ops.summary: Cannot be used while under the effect of Scatter Shot.

set.description: Increases melee, ranged and spellcasting Haste by 3%.

ops.summary: Haste bonus tripled from 1% to 3%.

previous.description: Increases melee, ranged and spellcasting Haste by 1%.

ops.summary: Cooldown reduced from 2 minutes to 90 seconds.

details: Blizzard's September 22 article spells the name “Read Ley Line”.

ops.summary: Can be cast while moving; minimum duration increased from 20 to 30 seconds.
